notes.title: 🚀 Raiders Rise – Update v0.5 is here!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!
We’ve just pushed a new update with lots of improvements to the game experience, performance, and stability. Take a look at what’s new:[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]🌍 Better Connections & Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]choose your game region/server[/b] from the Settings menu. This helps improve connection and reduce lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated our core tech under the hood (Photon & Quantum) to keep things running fast.[/p][/*][*][p]All 5 current Raiders have received [b]balance tweaks and polish[/b] to make combat feel even better:[/p][list][*][p]🛡️ [b]Jerar[/b][/p][p]Base HP: 750 → 700[/p][p]Basic attack damage: 45 → 50[/p][p]Primary ability hitbox adjusted (more accurate).[/p][p]Bugfix: passive no longer activates twice.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Kathy[/b][/p][p]Movement speed: 4.8 → 5.0[/p][p]Secondary ability damage: 90 → 80[/p][p]Improved visual clarity on ultimate.[/p][p]Bugfix: secondary now applies slow correctly.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]🐲 [b]Atabusk[/b][/p][p]Base HP: 1000 → 1100[/p][p]Ultimate cooldown: 40s → 35s[/p][p]New animation for ultimate.[/p][p]Audio tweaks on heavy attacks.[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 [b]Maya[/b][/p][p]Attack range: +0.5[/p][p]Attack speed: 1.2 → 1.0[/p][p]Optimized FX on secondary ability (better performance).[/p][p]Bugfix: projectile no longer passes through small obstacles.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]🔥 [b]Jak[/b][/p][p]Basic attack damage: 60 → 55[/p][p]Base HP: 650 → 700[/p][p]Improved sound feedback for basic attacks.[/p][p]Bugfix: ultimate no longer cancels accidentally.[/p][p]   [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]🖥️ New & Updated Menus[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Several screens have been freshly updated for clarity and style:
[/p][list][*][p]Add Friend, Enter Code[/p][/*][*][p]Character Selection[/p][/*][*][p]Reward & Post-Game screens[/p][/*][*][p]Settings[/p][/*][*][p]Pop-ups when you disconnect or quit
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Icons across the game have been touched up for a cleaner look.


[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes & Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI now scales correctly on different screen sizes and resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing enemies to get stuck in corners.[/p][/*][*][p]Small fixes across animations and character setups.[/p][/*][*][p]Jak’s dash issue when entering shop is now resolved! [/p][/*][*][p]Jerar’s ultimate whilst dashing issue is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimates showing earlier than expected due to poor connection is also resolved! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for playing Raiders Rise and helping us improve along the way!
If you want to continue providing feedback or give V0.5 a go, hop onto our Discord where we host play sessions every Saturday 10pm CET! [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ Raiders Rise Dev Update - More behind the scenes content!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Welcome back to another Raiders Rise dev update where we share what’s happening behind the scenes as we work toward release. Let’s jump in![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Player Experience Improvements[/b][/h3][p]We’re making the Friends Flow smoother than ever! Changing your name and managing your friends list (adding or removing players) will soon be more intuitive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/62c54bdbf6ceaedaae8caf0c1822a659d516a062.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/4c7373cd9b0a01b663164df347cc4dbd76a77894.png"][/img][/p][p]Also coming in v0.5: Regional Settings![/p][p]You’ll be able to select your preferred server region in Settings and view your ping. If left on default, the game will auto-select the best region based on your location, improving your matchmaking and overall experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7faded4a1ffab250ee63c664932dc3e6e8048f00.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧬 Characters & Skins[/b][/h3][p]On the concept side, Lence’s final design is now complete and ready for 3D production![/p][p]We’ve been expanding our skin library too:[/p][list][*][p]Zantetsu is getting our first pirate-themed skin[/p][/*][*][p]Jak and Sky are rocking new steampunk reskins[/p][/*][*][p]Nikky is joining Kathy in the J-pop themed lineup[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/302785f087b4e1cf9c37650396f26c45dc7e085d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/23235e09524281e1cd3e1b8dcf29272fe25f767a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/867f973efe4902c0bad4b020d392d914e1933f47.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9541c4c663cae6ec7bd11caece63160c936e1841.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5816a93cc0e06d3fb3f013f75cceb087526b83b7.png"][/img]
[/p][p]In 3D, Maya’s newest skin is finished and will become her base model. Blayze’s model is done, and Korin is ready to hit the stage with a disco-inspired Elvis skin.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a880e6ceab2a88a8672c7c1837d0c9d777b27311.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/cc85bcf9c63cf8b427f73de613632b06c19c8409.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b92f80485934244cfbafbe7e82de7790f1fbce0a.png"][/img]
[/p][p]For Animation, the team have been in full swing:[/p][list][*][p]Zantetsu’s movesets are in progress[/p][/*][*][p]Blayze’s animations are also underway. [/p][/*][*][p]Jerar’s Hell’s Angel skin and Kathy’s J-pop skin are coming to life and we even added keychain physics (tested on Kathy) for some extra flair![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/707f847b197969e83ebd86ad8201029a1aa33bf5.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d7b91fa848e6ba98a44644911d03e0e6ff0fbd4b.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5972bcd51f9ed30311ba057e19573a501e96b80c.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/c66f9488ab07a74234ec10ecdb973bc0cfdb6745.gif"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, in the VFX department, River’s teleport effect is done and the first round of Nikky’s VFX is progressing nicely.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/22e15876a88aac0d0affdd9012893a760f25f329.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2419af72deeec210fc2d4fa4f9636d813798e070.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🌍 Levels & Environments[/b][/h3][p]While Planet 2 is on hold for now, we’ve kicked off Planet 1.2![/p][p]This shift has given our environment artists a chance to explore more level design. The new desert biome continues to grow, we’ve added ancient ruins powered by crystals, tying directly into the lore of the Raiders and adding new layers of world-building.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/d32dbd6352723be123da1f8d3ee4167e8c57c19f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/45bf930574370bc49c98ecccdf1d9b49c26f1d92.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/384e67da99c7df040b5cb10b456ce23fd2bdabf4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/37f3a453ff16cd7a744f69edbfd65ec69d80b96c.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]📣 Join Us![/b][/h3][p]And that’s a wrap for this update![/p][p]If you’d like to help shape the game during development:[/p][p]💠 Wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376580/Raiders_Rise/"]Raiders Rise[/url] on Steam[/p][p]💬 Join our Discord for weekly play sessions every [b]Saturday at 10pm CET[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]Thanks for following along and we’ll see you in the next update![/p][p]

notes.title: 🛠 Raiders Rise Dev Update – New Skins, Planet 2, and More!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!
We’re back with another update from Raiders Rise, and there’s a lot of exciting stuff to share. Let’s dive in![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]🎯 Battle Pass & Missions Sneak Peak! [/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass Preview
[/b] You might’ve noticed the Battle Pass tab in-game. We’ve updated it to clearly show that it’s still in progress so players don’t get confused or think it’s broken.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mission Cleanup
[/b]Missions got a visual overhaul, this is how they're looking now! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/e23ac772170603fd3f8ce2aa35e611058b11c6b8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d0aea3997ec4fe5792f8d9b980d422a0f3a63ae.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎨 Raiders[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Latest Raiders! 
[/b]Huge thanks to everyone who participated in our polls! Final designs for Blayze and Bebbo are now locked in and looking great.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Skins Incoming[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Snowbird[/b]: Disco won but it was a close call with the Mafia skin! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Korin[/b]: He’s getting down with a disco-themed skin too, thanks to everyone who joined the live stream and helped shape it![/p][/*][*][p][b]Jerar & Kathy[/b]: New models are in. Jerar is sporting a Hell’s Angel aesthetic, and Kathy’s channeling J-pop energy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Zantetsu[/b]: His final model is complete and ready to animate! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Sky’s Moveset
[/b]Animations for [b]Sky[/b] are done. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Monster Animation Updates
[/b]We’ve improved the animations for the variations of the bee, big bee, and mortar enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VFX Passes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]River[/b]: Basic attack, silver bullet, and his sword ultimate now have full VFX. Better readability = better plays.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Bebbo & Blayze Final Concept[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/cd92cfe2d6630e2e307be3e249db65449a9178ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1c516ef96eb0e8aca8733322bc6ff350801b0eaa.png"][/img][/p][p]Snowbird, Korin, Jerar & Kathy Skins[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/b765e4ef5a0f3c17c58c7545e3b57a7c4dbc501f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/a559de483bc2147d7a797fab7124c8902b001951.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/7def9d3ea239127b8e81b3f25a922bea4ede438d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/1bbfa6745878aa195dbf3c18be76f2b310deddc2.png"][/img][/p][p]Zantetsu Model[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/6baa7b0a86f2d5bdf5a76235a7f8056aa12ec925.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌍 Planet 2! [/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Planet 2 Playtesting Begins
[/b]We’ve officially begun playtesting Planet 2! We tried out five brand-new levels and had a blast. There's still plenty of balancing and iteration ahead, but it’s a solid foundation to build on before we move onto adding the visuals to bring the level together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2feb34ebb0324ae2ed21b99f89bd6e0d1f3fe633.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🌵Environments[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Desert Biome Expands

[/b]We built a new tool that lets us make coral formations much faster. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/9f82f5fd31a6700e452a9896ddd196b2e4cf9bf8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5c0d60130128fca045db6f473f1a0dbb13cfb93b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/2e8dbc62fa7c3cdb0fb7ad9d84708b88a1af03ea.gif"][/img]

Selecting one takes you to their Cosmetics screen, where future skins and visual customizations will appear in the grey placeholder boxes.[/p][p]The Progression tab will allow players to check out their skill tree and if you're curious about their backstory or abilities, the Raider Information button will take you straight to their character info screen.[/p][p]Everything’s functional, though much of it is still placeholder, we’re excited to keep working on it! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/162a68e2861ebe61670f4a5582c46e504ac0bbaf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/49d4171ef30c880736ebd2d76b26c803aacc3d7d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/27e7ba67edfc51763a69e046a5542540642abb98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]💥Core[/b][/h2][p]We’ve made solid progress on the ultimates for River and Snowbird! [/p][p]River, who normally relies on his gun for basic attacks, now switches things up in his ultimate where he’ll use his blade for a powerful close-range strike.[/p][p]Snowbird’s passive skill is also in: he summons explosive clones that deal damage to monsters before detonating for extra impact. His ultimate creates a blue zone that slows enemies and gives himself an armor buff, making him much harder to take down.[/p][p]And exciting news: Nikky is officially in development! You’ll get a sneak peek at some of his early movesets below! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/71eec95cd3c51ce485389f7226a69f8f896d601f.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/5d4423d2064dda1ccab090425ffd3cbab8f0389c.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]🧑‍🚀Characters [/b][/h2][p]As always, the art side has been packed![/p][p]We’ve been exploring visual directions for our newest Raider, Blayze. [/p][p]Our concept artists have also been cooking up fresh skins for Maya, Jerar, and Kathy, giving familiar faces some brand-new flair.[/p][p]On the modeling front, both Sky and Atabusk’s models are now complete! Fun fact: the current in-game version of Atabusk will become a skin, while this new model will be his official base look going forward.[/p][p]Enemies are getting some love too, we’ve updated the Mortar and Big Bee with new visual variations to bring more personality to the battlefield.[/p][p]And over in animation, we’re wrapping up the final animations for Korin, Nikky, and River, with Sky’s rig now well underway.
[/p][p][b]Blayze Concept Exploration[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/02976c5c5b431ccb508c05f206b2eb749c7a175a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Zantetsu Concept[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45360127/bcaa6e8d037cdbc0c9ae6343882c8643f3cb1d72.png"][/img]

notes.title: Welcome to Raiders Rise! – A New Kind of 3v3 Battleground
notes.notes:
The year is 16,514... the universe is vast, chaotic, and full of possibilities. But most importantly: it's way more [b]fun with friends.[/b]

Five houses compete for the Crystals, the most valuable resource in the universe. And, conveniently, they're willing to pay handsomely for someone like you.

You're a Raider. An explorer. An expert at [b]finding Crystals[/b] and sticking your nose where it probably shouldn't be. But don’t worry, you won’t be doing this alone. Team up with your friends, plan the perfect extraction, and get ready for action.

Travel together to hostile worlds. Extract Crystals with ease... or at least try to. [b]Encounter creatures[/b] that can't tell the difference between a Raider and an intergalactic snack.
And of course, other teams are after the same prize. You can't attack them directly, but you can play a few "harmless pranks"... like blocking their path, triggering traps, or convincing them that the big red button doesn't do anything dangerous.

In the end, [b]each team keeps what they collect[/b], but only one will be the true winner. The competition is fierce, but the laughs are guaranteed.

Welcome to Raiders Rise! Gather your team, plan wisely... and most importantly, don't be the one who sets off the trap by accident.


[h3]Forget stiff, sweaty competitive games—this is something new.[/h3]

[list]
[*] 3v3 Competitive & Cooperative PvPvE Battles – Work with your team while surviving the wild.
[*] Short, Action-Packed Matches – 15-20 minutes of pure intensity—no downtime.
[*] A Multiplayer Bullet Hell with Party Game Chaos – Dodge, strategize, and adapt in fast-paced battles.
[*] No More Toxicity – A space where teamwork, fun, and epic moments take the spotlight.
[/list]

If you love fast-paced action with just the right mix of competition and unpredictable fun, this is for you.
